\begin{example} \end{example}[Product with a circle is not $\kappa $-non-collapsed] ↗ def:ancient-solution ↗ def:kappa-noncollapsed

For the ancient product flow $g(t)=(1-t)g_0+ds^2$ on $S^2\times S^1_R$, \[ |\Rm (p,t)|=(1-t)^{-1},\qquad \frac{\Vol _{g(t)}B(p,\sqrt{1-t})}{(1-t)^{3/2}} \leq \frac{8\pi ^2R}{\sqrt{1-t}}\longrightarrow 0 \] as $t\to -\infty $. Hence it is not $\kappa $-non-collapsed for any $\kappa >0$. \end{example}
